title: Conditioning ramps: metcon ramp before finisher metcons + engine-test ramp
what: training.yaml item_sets metcon_ramp (2 min easy erg building to workout pace for the last 30 s, then one light practice round, ~1 min rest) inserted before the metcon in squat_hyrox, upper_skill_metcon and upper_hyp_metcon; engine_test_ramp (5 min easy, 3 x 10 s at test pace, 2 min easy, start within 3 min) for engine test days (bike/row/ski), same at every retest. Standalone Hyrox/Open days keep the conditioning warm-up (already progressive); threshold runs keep their warm-up miles; travel bodyweight metcon unchanged.
why: Athlete asked that conditioning gets a proper warm-up like the heavy lifts. A finisher metcon after lifting starts from low HR and different movements, and short max efforts go better after a brief specific ramp; it costs ~3-4 min. A fixed engine-test ramp keeps retests comparable. Confidence: moderate.

history.note: athlete asked in chat; config applied; awaiting coach approve by the athlete
